project_type: Monorepo: Python/FastAPI backend, Cloudflare Worker (TypeScript) edge, React/Vite frontend, Azure Bicep infra
build_system: pip with requirements.txt (hashes), npm/pnpm for frontend/edge, Azure Bicep for infra
test_framework: No formal test suite found; validation via AST/syntax checks
build_command: python -m py_compile for Python files; az bicep build for Bicep
verification_instructions: 1. Python files: run py_compile on each new/modified .py file. 2. Bicep files: validate syntax with az bicep build (if available) or manual review. 3. Shell scripts: bash -n for syntax check.
setup_instructions: Python 3.12 environment; pip install not required for syntax validation
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no pip install, no docker build, no external network. Use AST/syntax validation only.
contribution_requirements: Separate commits per logical change. Descriptive commit messages.
key_patterns: Backend uses FastAPI with app factory pattern (create_app in main.py). Middleware added via @app.middleware decorators. Logging uses Python stdlib logging module. Existing telemetry in app/core/telemetry.py (OpenTelemetry). Infra uses Bicep modules referenced from main.bicep. Scripts directory has bash scripts.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/core/ - core modules (telemetry, security, circuit_breaker, rate_limiter). apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - API endpoints. infra/azure/ - Bicep templates. scripts/ - utility scripts. .github/workflows/ - CI/CD.
